e.title: Insurance Pricing Tweedie (freMTPL2)
e.summary: 车险纯保费定价（繁体中文，freMTPL2 678,013 保单）：曝险处理/损失函数选择/验收标准
e.body: Insurance Pricing Tweedie 用法国第三方责任车险公开数据 freMTPL2（678,013 张保单）检验定价模型的三件事：曝险处理、损失函数选择、以及『怎样才算验收通过』（排序对了不代表保费够）——繁体中文教学实现，CI 完备。对 RIAA：车险纯保费（Tweedie）定价的完整教学范例（与 Risk Atlas 三语 wiki 的繁中语境契合）。与 [[claim-frequency]]（DAV 理赔频率）、[[cplm]]（复合泊松）、[[tweedie]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[casdatasets]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：freMTPL2（678,013 保单）车险纯保费定价（曝险/损失函数/验收），繁体中文，CI
e.summary_en: Motor pure-premium pricing (Traditional Chinese, freMTPL2 678,013 policies): exposure handling / loss-function choice / acceptance criteria
e.summary_hk: 車險純保費定價（繁體中文，freMTPL2 678,013 保單）：曝險處理/損失函數選擇/驗收標準
e.body_en: Insurance Pricing Tweedie uses the French third-party-liability motor public dataset freMTPL2 (678,013 policies) to test three things about pricing models: exposure handling, loss-function selection, and 'what counts as acceptance' (being correctly ranked does not mean the premium is enough) — a Traditional-Chinese teaching implementation, CI-complete. For RIAA: a complete teaching example of motor pure-premium (Tweedie) pricing (fitting the trilingual Risk Atlas wiki's Traditional-Chinese context). Complements [[claim-frequency]] (DAV claim frequency), [[cplm]] (compound Poisson) and [[tweedie]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[machine-learning-pricing]], [[casdatasets]].
e.body_hk: Insurance Pricing Tweedie 用法國第三方責任車險公開數據 freMTPL2（678,013 張保單）檢驗定價模型的三件事：曝險處理、損失函數選擇、以及『怎樣才算驗收通過』（排序對了不代表保費夠）——繁體中文教學實現，CI 完備。對 RIAA：車險純保費（Tweedie）定價的完整教學範例（與 Risk Atlas 三語 wiki 的繁中語境契合）。與 [[claim-frequency]]（DAV 理賠頻率）、[[cplm]]（複合泊松）、[[tweedie]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[casdatasets]]。
